description: M11 TR-17: the shipped bundle budget. kb compile fails at +20 % over bundleBytes; the compile test holds the packed bundle under bundleBytes and its gzip under bundleGzipBytes. Lowered from 1 MB to 720 KB in release 7 (perf/kb-slim): the packed codec (pack.ts) took the bundle from 1,023 KB to 574 KB, so this leaves about 25 % headroom for M5, M18 and M19. The compiled Knowledge Base ships only in the parse worker chunk. M23 (Bubba) adds 4.3 KB gzip (the six Checks, the visit Goal, four Priority Lists and six small game tables) to a bundle at 160.9 KB gzip, 2.9 KB under the old 160 KB budget, so the gzip budget moved to 165 KB. M26 (class Builds past the third class: 27 Builds for the elite, master and Journeyman-line classes) took the packed bundle to 753 KB after Source notes stopped shipping, and its gzip to 171.5 KB, so bundleBytes moved to 768 KB and bundleGzipBytes to 180 KB (the parse worker chunk only). M26 Wave C adds the anvil recipe table (anvil.fact.recipes: all 300 W1-W4 recipes with name, tab, position, Smithing level, unlock and materials, read by the Anvil Recipes tab, the gate links and the Walkthrough's Smithing gates), the anvil product table and the Production Plan entries: the packed bundle to 780 KB and its gzip to 187.8 KB, so bundleBytes moved to 832 KB and bundleGzipBytes to 196 KB (the parse worker chunk only).
